description_en: Queries the list of Data Service business processes
description_zh: 调用ListDataServiceGroups查询数据服务业务流程列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-service-groups --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --project-id 10000 --tenant-id 10001 --group-name-keyword '测试业务流程' --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataServiceGroups

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The workspace ID.

You can obtain this value from PageResult.ProjectList[].ProjectId in the response of the ListProjects operation
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间的ID。

可通过 ListProjects 响应中的 PageResult.ProjectList[].ProjectId 获取
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the business process name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程名称关键词，可以进行子串匹配
parameters.name: group_name_keyword
